gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma in Patients ≥70 Years

candidate_evidence.quote: The NovoTTF-200 A device used in this trial delivers very low intensity, alternating electric fields to the tumor site through the scalp.
Chemoradiotherapy with temozolomide and hypofractionated radiotherapy is regarded as standard therapy and not part of the intervention.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed, newly diagnosed glioblastoma (astrocytoma WHO grade IV)

coder_notes: Device-only trial (TTFields timing). Temozolomide is optional ('with or without', per local standard) and explicitly 'not part of the intervention', not a registered intervention and not given to every patient, so it is not listed as an agent (R9). Eligibility text says age >65 while the title says >=70; not relevant to coding.
